title: Hen Wlad Fy Nhadau
studyTransform: Upper MIDI track; highest note at simultaneous onsets; first 32 bars; durations quantized to sixteenth notes. Accompaniment and performance markings omitted.

rights: The composition and this Mutopia edition are supplied as Public Domain. Edition source: Llyfrgell Genedlaethol Cymru. The included PDF and original MIDI are unchanged. The editable notation is a 28-bar upper-part study (maximum 32 bars) derived from the MIDI, not the complete score.
description: Song music for Voice. Complete source PDF plus an editable upper-part practice study.
